text: さんか　したい　ひとは　カウンターに　おこしください

structure.jp: さんか　したい　ひとは
structure.en: people who want to take part

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい after a verb stem means 'want to do'. さんか　したい = 'want to take part'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: さんか　したい　ひとは
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase right before a noun describes that noun. さんか　したい　ひと = 'people who want to take part'.

patterns.name: お〜ください
patterns.explanation: お plus the verb stem plus ください is a polite request. おこしください = 'please come'.
